notes: Australian Agricultural Company (AACo) — ASX-listed integrated cattle producer. Fiscal year ends 31 March; H1 ends 30 September. Owns ~6.4M ha (~15.8M acres) of cattle stations across Northern Territory and Queensland, plus feedlots and Darwin abattoir (mothballed 2018). IFRS reporting with biological assets (cattle herd) carried at fair value, and pastoral land/property carried at fair value through directors' valuations supplemented by independent appraisals (LAWD). Statutory results highly volatile due to non-cash livestock and property revaluations; AACo discloses operating EBITDA pre-revaluation as primary KPI. Brand-led wagyu/branded beef strategy (Westholme, Darling Downs, 1824). Production reported in kg meat sold and head-of-cattle. Acreage held essentially constant ~17,000K acres FY20-FY25.

periods.notes: H1 FY20 (1HFY20): statutory revenue $199.9M, operating EBITDA $9.8M (pre-revaluation), statutory loss $16.5M. Drought conditions weighed on margins.
FY20 (year ended 31 Mar 2020): statutory revenue $263.5M, operating EBITDA $(5.6)M, statutory loss $44.4M reflecting drought and livestock revaluation declines. Property assets $1,480.6M.
1HFY21: revenue $137.0M (-31% on lower live cattle volumes, COVID food-service disruption), operating EBITDA $8.4M, statutory NPAT $6.7M aided by livestock fair-value uplift as drought broke.
FY21: operating EBITDA $13.5M; statutory NPAT $134.7M boosted by $144.4M cattle/property fair-value uplift as Australian cattle prices reached record highs.
1HFY22: revenue $138.1M, operating EBITDA $12.0M, statutory NPAT $117.1M (significant herd FV uplift).
FY22: revenue $318.4M (+21% YoY on branded beef growth and cattle prices), operating EBITDA $31.0M, statutory NPAT $137.0M. Property carried at $1,685M.
FY23: revenue $364.2M (+14%), operating EBITDA $60.2M (record), statutory loss $(27.5)M after $59.8M unfavourable cattle FV movements (cattle price decline).
1HFY24: revenue $200.0M, operating EBITDA $28.1M, statutory loss $(49.0)M reflecting cattle price-driven livestock devaluation.
FY24: revenue $380M, operating EBITDA $52.6M, statutory loss $(34.6)M. Cattle FV losses continued through softer market.
1HFY25: revenue $198.0M, operating EBITDA $26.7M, statutory NPAT $12.4M as cattle prices stabilised.

FY25 (year ended 31 Mar 2025; reported 21 May 2025): revenue $387.9M, operating EBITDA $56.3M, NAV/share $2.55. Independent LAWD valuation indicated property FMV ~$1,588M; balance sheet carries pastoral land at directors' valuation $1,685M.
